title: Exponential code bound
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, and let $n,s\in\mathbb{N}$. Then $2^{c(N)(s+\log_2^+(n)+1)}\leq 2^{c(N)(s+g(n)+1)}$, where $c(N)$ is the machine’s code-size parameter, $\log_2^+(n)=\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor+1$ (with value $1$ at $n=0$), and $g(n)=1$ when $n=0$ and $g(n)=\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor+2$ when $n>0$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
